Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a chemist and a construction worker agreed to help raise money for their local community center. Though the chemist was really helpful in the organization and running of several different events and raised a ton of money in the end, the construction worker was more trouble than they were worth and ended up mixing up dates, forgetting when they needed to complete different tasks, and really just couldn't do anything helpful at all. Who is competent?
A. The chemist
B. The construction worker
C. Undetermined
